rationale: For baseline fraud detection on imbalanced synthetic medical claims: (1) Select predictive features (claim characteristics and financial amounts) while excluding label-derived fraud_pattern_type (12K+ nulls suggest target-derived) and identifiers to prevent leakage, per task's leakage tag. (2) Stratified 75/25 split maintains fraud class prevalence in both train and test, addressing class_imbalance tag. (3) Fit preprocessing on train_only (leakage prevention) and apply standard scaling to support logistic regression without harming tree-based models. (4) Train logistic_regression (interpretable baseline) and random_forest (nonlinear patterns) with balanced class_weight to handle fraud class imbalance. (5) Report includes synthetic_data caveat (per skill evolved_run_006_001), class_imbalance (reflects data characteristics), and model_limitations (reflects baseline nature).
